messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Whenever I watch fireworks,{01 00 00 05 00}
all my problems and worries
just fly away!
{07 04 00}W-{01 00 00 05 00}what?{01 01 00}{07 03 00} Of COURSE I have
problems, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Even
I'm not THAT perfect!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Kui ma vaatan ilutulestikku,{01 00 00 05 00}
lendavad kõik mu mured ja
probleemid lihtsalt minema!
{07 04 00}M-{01 00 00 05 00}mis?{01 01 00}{07 03 00} MUIDUGI on mul
probleeme, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Isegi
mina pole NII täiuslik!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oooo... It's almost time for
the big huge GRAND FINALE!
Whooo! I can't wait!
{07 0d 00}I'm soooo excited, I think
I'm gonna EXPLODE! {01 00 00 05 00}Just like
a FIRECRACKER, {04 02 00}!!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ohhh... Varsti on aeg
suureks SUURFINAALIKS!
Uhuu! Ma ei jõua oodata!
{07 0d 00}Olen nii elevil, et vist
PLAHVATAN! {01 00 00 05 00}Just nagu
PAUKPADRUN, {04 02 00}!!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}The fireworks are almost
over...{01 00 00 0a 00} Soon we'll just have
memories of smoke and ash.
{07 09 00}I hope people remember me
once I'm gone, too{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00} Wow,
that's TOTALLY morbid...
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ilutulestik on peaaegu
läbi...{01 00 00 0a 00} Varsti on meil vaid
mälestused suitsust ja tuhast.
{07 09 00}Loodan, et mind mäletatakse
ka, kui olen läinud{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00} Vau,
see on TÄIESTI morbiidne...

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Today's fireworks are nearly
over, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Wow, it
happened so fast...
{07 16 00}Y'know, I thought LAST 
year's fireworks were kinda
better than these{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Maybe we're, like,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00} in a
firework recession...
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tänane ilutulestik on
peaaegu läbi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Vau,
see läks nii kiiresti...
{07 16 00}Tead, ma arvasin, et EELMISE
aasta ilutulestik oli
veidi parem kui see{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Ehk oleme, nagu,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}
ilutulestikukriisis...

messages.en:
{07 14 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show {ff 00 00 00}just
started, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0d 00}I hope you totally enjoy it,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

{07 04 00}Huh?!{01 01 00} What?!{01 01 00} WHAT?!


{07 06 00}Sorry, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! The
fireworks are too loud!{01 00 00 05 00}
I can't hear you!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mis?!{01 01 00} Mida?!{01 01 00} MIDA?!


{07 06 00}Vabandust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ilutulestik on liiga vali!{01 00 00 05 00}
Ma ei kuule sind!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}This is the midpoint of 
this year's {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 15 00}I feel like it's the mid-
point of my life, too!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See on selle aasta
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00} keskpunkt!

{07 15 00}Mulle tundub, et see on ka
mu elu keskpunkt!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}These awesome fireworks
wouldn't be possible without
the firework creators...
{07 13 00}Someday I wanna be able to
do something amazing for
everyone to see!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Need vägevad ilutulestikud
poleks võimalikud ilma
ilutulestiku tegijateta...
{07 13 00}Kunagi tahan ma teha
midagi imelist, mida kõik
saaksid vaadata!

messages.en:
{07 0f 00}Oh...{01 00 00 0a 00} Today is the last
{ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show {ff 00 00 00}of the
year...
{07 00 00}{07 0d 00}But I'm already looking
forward to NEXT YEAR's
{ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0f 00}Oi...{01 00 00 0a 00} Täna on selle aasta
viimane {ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow
{ff 00 00 00}...
{07 00 00}{07 0d 00}Aga ma ootan juba
JÄRGMISE AASTA
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushowd{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm gonna take one last look
at this year's fireworks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 10 00}Goodbye, {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Goodbye, pretty colors!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Goodbye...
{07 14 00}Aw, heck!{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm just gonna
enjoy this now and get all
mushy later, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma vaatan viimast korda
selle aasta ilutulestikku,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 10 00}Hüvasti, {ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Hüvasti, ilusad värvid!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Hüvasti...
{07 14 00}Ah, mis seal!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma lihtsalt
naudin seda nüüd ja lähen
pärast hellaks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
